messages.title: Ohtia
messages.intro: Your research will be kept in the ohtia folder in your user home.
messages.status_unavailable: The local service is unavailable. Retry or exit.
messages.missing: No research data has been opened or created yet.
messages.located: A saved location awaits compatibility checks. No data has been opened.
messages.pending_create: No research data has been opened or created yet.
messages.locator_invalid: The saved location record is invalid. It has been preserved. Check it before continuing.
messages.locator_newer: The saved location requires a newer application. Use a compatible version.
messages.locator_unreadable: The saved location cannot be read. Check access and retry.
messages.path_rejected: The account’s ohtia folder or saved location cannot be used safely. Existing data is preserved.
messages.startup_failed: Ohtia could not start safely. Check the isolated profile and application files, then retry.
messages.shutdown_uncertain: The local service has not been confirmed stopped. Keep this window open and check the process before exiting.
messages.resource_failure: The application reached its process limit. Close extra windows and retry.
messages.storage_failed: Local data could not be opened. Existing files are preserved. Check access and retry.
messages.recovery_required: A database update needs attention. Retry after inspection or recover the verified checkpoint.
messages.publication_uncertain: The location save is unconfirmed. Data is preserved. Retry to inspect the outcome.
messages.storage_disclosure: Before a schema update, Ohtia keeps a complete local database checkpoint. Recovery may also retain failed files and journals. These copies have the same sensitivity as your data.
messages.save_failed: The save failed. Your input is preserved.
messages.save_uncertain: The save is unconfirmed. Check its receipt before saving again.
messages.refresh_preference: This preference changed in another window. Refresh before saving.
messages.locale_fallback: The saved interface language is invalid. Ohtia is using your system language. The saved value is preserved.
messages.retry_required: The update stopped without a verified checkpoint. Your data is preserved. Retry to inspect the source and continue.
messages.checkpoint_restored: The verified checkpoint has been restored. Data remains closed. Retry to validate and update it before opening.
messages.storage_opening: Opening local data. Please wait; you can exit.
messages.settings.language.title: Language
messages.settings.language.help: Changing the language does not translate documents or change the language of analyses.
messages.settings.language.rejected: Language could not be saved. The previous choice, {value}, is retained.
messages.settings.language.uncertain: It is not yet known whether the language was saved. Its receipt is being checked without sending the change twice.
messages.settings.language.conflict: Another window saved a language meanwhile. That choice is now used.
messages.settings.language.changed: Another window changed the language to {value}.
messages.settings.language.applyFailed: Language saved, but it could not be applied in this window.
messages.settings.language.readFailed: Language could not be loaded. Check the connection and refresh.
messages.settings.language.recovered: No saved change was found after the service recovered. Choose again to make a new change.
messages.command.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.
messages.about.loadFailed: Version information could not be loaded. Close and reopen this dialog to try again.
messages.about.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the version text and copy it manually.
messages.about.description: A local workspace for academic research.
messages.command.reason.handler_missing: This control is not available in this version.
messages.command.reason.no_edit_target: Focus a text field or select text first.
messages.command.reason.busy: Wait for the current action to finish.
messages.command.reason.last_panel: At least one panel must stay visible.
messages.command.reason.window_limit: Close another window before opening a new one.
messages.help.capabilities: This version opens local data, changes language and appearance, and provides offline help and version details. Research projects and connected analysis are not yet available.
messages.help.language.text: Choose the interface language or use your system language. This does not translate documents or change the language of analyses.
messages.help.appearance.text: Choose system, light or dark appearance for Ohtia windows.
messages.help.characters.text: Allow character movement when motion is available. Keep character illustrations still. Show compact symbols only.
messages.help.layout.text: Change panel visibility and reset the layout in Settings. Changes apply to this window and future windows; other open windows keep their arrangement.
messages.about.copyOutsideFailed: Copy failed. Open About Ohtia to select and copy the version text manually.
messages.workspace.zoom: Interface zoom {percent}. Return to actual size
messages.workspace.welcomeText: Start a project and set it up with Virgilio. You can also adjust language, appearance, zoom and layout in Settings.
messages.workspace.chatEmpty: Create a project to talk with Virgilio.
messages.workspace.notRemembered: The layout could not be remembered. Your current arrangement is kept in this window.
messages.workspace.uncertain: It is not yet known whether the layout was saved. Check the original request without sending it twice.
messages.workspace.helpLayout: Workspace layout controls panel visibility and widths.
messages.command.reason.wide_layout: Make the window wider to use document focus mode.
messages.settings.immediate: Changes save immediately. Language, appearance, zoom and characters apply to every Ohtia window.
messages.settings.zoomPending: A zoom change is being saved or checked. Wait before changing zoom again.
messages.settings.animatedHelp: Allow character movement when motion is available.
messages.settings.reducedMotion: The character stays still while your system asks to reduce motion.
messages.settings.layoutHelp: Changes apply to this window and windows opened later. Other open windows keep their arrangement.
messages.settings.rejected: {setting} could not be saved. The previous value, {value}, is retained.
messages.settings.uncertain: It is not yet known whether {setting} was saved. Its receipt is being checked without sending it twice.
messages.settings.conflict: Another window saved {setting} meanwhile. That value is now used.
messages.settings.applyFailed: {setting} was saved, but could not be applied in this window.
messages.settings.readFailed: Preferences could not be refreshed. Saved changes remain saved. Refresh to check the current values.
messages.settings.fallback: The saved {setting} is invalid. A safe fallback is shown without replacing the saved record.
messages.settings.title: Settings
messages.settings.layoutNotRemembered: This window keeps its arrangement, but the layout could not be remembered.
messages.settings.layoutConflict: Another window saved a layout meanwhile. This window keeps its arrangement. Choose again to make a new change.
messages.settings.displayFailed: {setting} could not be applied in this window.
messages.settings.unavailable: Preferences are unavailable until local data and the local service are ready.
messages.settings.zoomUnavailable: The last zoom action was unavailable. Check the current preferences before trying again.

messages.shortcuts.separator.reset: Reset the pair to default widths
messages.connection.title: Connections
messages.connection.waiting: Finish signing in to {service} in your browser.
messages.connection.timeout: Sign-in wasn’t completed within 10 minutes. Try again when you’re ready.
messages.connection.storeUnavailable: Ohtia keeps your sign-in in your system’s keyring, which isn’t available. Turn on or unlock GNOME Keyring or KWallet, then sign in again.
messages.connection.planNotAllowed: Ohtia doesn’t have permission to use your {service} plan.
messages.connection.rejected: Ohtia can’t use this {service} sign-in. Sign in again.
messages.connection.expired: Your {service} session expired. Sign in again.
messages.connection.unknownPlan: {service} doesn’t say in advance whether your plan can be used in Ohtia. The first reply will show it.
messages.connection.unreachable: Ohtia couldn’t reach {service}. Your sign-in is kept; check your internet connection and test again.
messages.connection.browserComplete: You can close this tab and return to Ohtia.
messages.exit.title: Quit Ohtia while replies are running?
messages.exit.cancelling: Ohtia is cancelling the work and saving replies.
messages.exit.body: {running, plural, one {# reply is still running. Replies that haven’t started are kept for the next time you open Ohtia, unless you cancel the work.} other {# replies are still running. Replies that haven’t started are kept for the next time you open Ohtia, unless you cancel the work.}}
messages.exit.waiting: {running, plural, one {Ohtia will quit when the running replies finish. # still running.} other {Ohtia will quit when the running replies finish. # still running.}}
messages.exit.queued: Replies that haven’t started are kept for the next time you open Ohtia, unless you cancel the work.

messages.history.title: Conversations
messages.history.name: Conversation name
messages.history.failed: Ohtia couldn’t load the conversations. They’re still saved.
messages.history.olderFailed: Ohtia couldn’t load older conversations. They’re still saved.
messages.history.rename.empty: Enter a name, or press Esc to keep the current one.
messages.history.rename.spaces: Remove the spaces at the start or end of the name.
messages.history.rename.long: {excess, plural, one {Remove # character to save this name.} other {Remove # characters to save this name.}}
messages.history.rename.stale: This conversation was renamed in another window. Press Enter to use your name instead.
messages.history.rename.uncertain: Ohtia couldn’t confirm that the name was saved. Press Enter to check; it won’t be saved twice.
messages.history.rename.failed: Ohtia couldn’t rename this conversation. Your name is still in the field; press Enter to try again.
messages.conversation.empty: This conversation has no messages yet.
messages.conversation.failed: Ohtia couldn’t load this conversation. Its messages are still saved.
messages.conversation.unavailable: Conversations are unavailable until local data and the local service are ready.
messages.conversation.earlierFailed: Ohtia couldn’t load earlier messages. They’re still saved.
messages.conversation.copyFailed: Ohtia couldn’t copy this message. Select its text and copy it manually.

messages.limits.subscription: More replies at once can use more of your {service} plan at the same time.
messages.limits.apiKey: More replies at once can spend your {service} key’s credit faster.
messages.limits.connectionLimit: {service} allows at most {connection_limit, plural, one {# reply at a time.} other {# replies at a time.}}

messages.composer.empty: Write a message to send it.
messages.composer.sending: Sending your message. The button now stops the replies.
messages.composer.pendingLimit: Too many replies are waiting. Your message wasn’t sent and is still in the box; send it again when some finish.
messages.composer.inputTooLarge: This message is too long for {agent} to read. Your message wasn’t sent and is still in the box; shorten it and send it again.
messages.composer.uncertain: Ohtia couldn’t confirm that your message was saved. Send it again to check; it won’t be saved twice.
messages.composer.failed: Ohtia couldn’t save your message. Your text is still in the box; send it again to retry.
messages.composer.stopFailed: Ohtia couldn’t confirm that the replies stopped. Try stopping them again.
messages.composer.replaceTitle: Replace the text in the box?
messages.composer.replaceBody: Reusing this message replaces the text you’re writing.
messages.composer.destinationFailed: Ohtia couldn’t read where this message would go. Refresh before sending it.
messages.taskNotice.waitingAgent: Waiting for {running_agent} to finish the current reply.
messages.taskNotice.waitingLimit: {running_limit, plural, one {Waiting to start: the limit of # reply at the same time is reached.} other {Waiting to start: the limit of # replies at the same time is reached.}}
messages.taskNotice.replying: Sent to {service}. Waiting for the reply.
messages.taskNotice.disconnected: {service} isn’t connected. {agent} will reply when you connect.
messages.taskNotice.usage.subscription: You’ve reached your {service} plan’s usage limit. Ohtia paused new requests to {service}.
messages.taskNotice.usage.apiKey: {service} says this key’s account has no credit or reached its spending limit. Ohtia paused new requests to {service}.
messages.taskNotice.restart: Ohtia stopped before this reply started.
messages.taskNotice.stopUsage: {service} doesn’t confirm whether the reply stopped on its side, so its full usage is unknown.
messages.taskNotice.partialInvalid: Incomplete — Ohtia couldn’t read the rest of the reply
messages.taskNotice.notEligible.subscription: {service} doesn’t allow this account to use its plan in Ohtia. Sign out in Settings › Connections, then choose “Sign in with another account”, or connect another service.
messages.taskNotice.notEligible.apiKey: {service} doesn’t allow this key to make this request. Check the key’s permissions in your {service} account, or replace it in Settings › Connections.
messages.taskNotice.expired.subscription: Your {service} session expired. Sign in again in Settings › Connections.
messages.taskNotice.expired.apiKey: {service} no longer accepts this key. Replace it in Settings › Connections.
messages.taskNotice.outputLimit: The reply was longer than Ohtia allows.
messages.taskNotice.attempts: This reply couldn’t start: both attempts ended before it was sent.
messages.taskNotice.uncertain.subscription: Ohtia lost contact with {service} while it was replying. {service} may have finished and counted this reply against your plan; Ohtia can’t know.
messages.taskNotice.uncertain.apiKey: Ohtia lost contact with {service} while it was replying. {service} may have finished and charged this reply to your key’s account; Ohtia can’t know.
messages.taskNotice.confirm.subscription: Starting again may count this reply against your plan twice.
messages.taskNotice.confirm.apiKey: Starting again may charge this reply to your key’s account twice.
messages.taskNotice.newer: A newer reply already answers these messages.
messages.taskNotice.pendingLimit: Too many replies are waiting. Nothing was started; try again when some finish.
messages.taskNotice.actionFailed: Ohtia couldn’t save this action. Nothing changed; you can try again.
messages.taskNotice.actionUncertain: Ohtia couldn’t confirm that this action was saved. Use the button again to check; it won’t run twice.
messages.taskNotice.destinationDisconnected: {service} isn’t connected. Messages will wait until you connect.
messages.taskNotice.destinationPaused.subscriptio: Requests to {service} are paused: plan limit reached. Messages will wait.
messages.taskNotice.destinationPaused.apiKey: Requests to {service} are paused: no credit or spending limit reached. Messages will wait.
messages.taskNotice.modelsLoading: Updating {service}’s model list before starting the reply.

messages.project.connectBody: Virgilio needs a connected AI service to help you set up the project.
messages.project.createFailedBody: Nothing was created, and your other projects are safe.
messages.project.openFailedTitle: Ohtia couldn’t open the new thesis
messages.project.openFailedBody: The thesis was created. Try again to open it; nothing will be created twice.
messages.setup.navigator: Talk with Virgilio in the chat to set up your thesis.
messages.setup.navigatorConfirmed: The Navigator isn’t available in this version. Talk with Virgilio in the chat.
messages.setup.explorer: Sources and documents aren’t available in this version.

messages.setup.title: Proposed thesis setup
messages.setup.responded: You replied in chat. This proposal can no longer be confirmed.
messages.setup.notWaiting: This proposal is no longer awaiting a decision.
messages.setup.warning: Virgilio and the other agents will work in this language. In this version, the title and language can’t be changed after you confirm.
messages.setup.waitForReply: Wait for Virgilio to finish replying.
messages.setup.confirmReplaced: A newer proposal replaced this one. Nothing was confirmed.
messages.setup.rejectReplaced: A newer proposal replaced this one. Nothing was rejected.
messages.setup.replyActive: Virgilio started replying first. Nothing was confirmed; confirm the setup when he finishes.
messages.setup.confirmFailed: Ohtia couldn’t confirm the setup. Nothing was saved; you can confirm it again.
messages.setup.rejectFailed: Ohtia couldn’t reject the setup. Nothing was saved; you can reject it again.
messages.setup.confirmUncertain: Ohtia couldn’t tell whether the setup was confirmed. Confirm it again to check; nothing will be saved twice.
messages.setup.rejectUncertain: Ohtia couldn’t tell whether the proposal was rejected. Reject it again to check; nothing will be saved twice.
messages.setup.confirmed: Confirmed. Ohtia saved the title and language; it doesn’t evaluate them.
messages.setup.invalid.title_whitespace: Virgilio proposed a title with spaces at the start or end.
messages.setup.invalid.title_too_long: Virgilio proposed a title longer than {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
messages.setup.invalid.title_invalid: Virgilio proposed a title Ohtia can’t read.
messages.setup.invalid.language_malformed: Virgilio proposed a language code Ohtia can’t read: {tag}.
messages.setup.invalid.language_unknown: Virgilio proposed a language code that doesn’t exist: {tag}.
messages.setup.invalid.multiple_calls: Virgilio made more than one proposal in one reply.
messages.setup.invalid.nextReply: Virgilio will see this in his next reply.

messages.project.createUncertainBody: Try again to check and open the thesis; nothing will be created twice.
